AboutSection.description1: Bharatiya Vyapar Mahotsav (BVM) 2026 — India's largest Make-In-India multi-sectoral trade expo — is designed to bring together India's diverse business ecosystem under one roof, connecting traders, MSMEs, manufacturers, industry leaders, institutions, and policymakers from across the country.
AboutSection.description2: More than a conventional exhibition, BVM enables meaningful business engagement through sector-focused zones, buyer–seller interactions, and knowledge sessions — showcasing the scale, diversity, and potential of Indian enterprise on a unified national platform.
AboutSection.ministryCaption: Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Govt. of India

AboutOrganiserSection.itpoP1: Established in 1972, India Trade Promotion Organisation has been at the forefront of promoting trade and commerce in India. Operating under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India, ITPO is headquartered at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi.
AboutOrganiserSection.itpoP2: Over the span of 50 years, ITPO has carved a long-established legacy of excellence in the Indian MICE industry through its innovative and visionary approach to trade promotion. Equipped with state-of-the-art infrastructure and ICT systems, it is committed to showcasing India's strengths in trade and commerce, blending the best of global and local expertise.
AboutOrganiserSection.caitP1: The Confederation of All India Traders (CAIT) founded in year 1990 is a leading national organization representing the interests of over 9 crore traders and small businesses across India. Established with the goal of empowering the Indian trading community, CAIT has been at the forefront of advocating for policies that promote the growth and sustainability of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), retailers, and traders.
AboutOrganiserSection.caitP2: With a vast network of over 40,000 trade associations, CAIT serves as the voice of Indian traders, working tirelessly to protect their rights, ensure fair trade practices, and drive policy reforms that foster business-friendly environments.

CommonMarketSection.celebratingIconAlt: Celebrating The Great Indian Common Market
CommonMarketSection.paragraph1: In Europe a Common Market came into being only in 1992 and was hailed as a major breakthrough. In India, we have had a ready Common Market from ever. It is perhaps the largest in the world in terms of the sheer number of transactions that take place, in goods and services. While there are estimates of market size in value, there is no measure of the transactions that take place. Its the real indicator of the exchange that takes place. Like the proverbial Akshayapatra, the market gives endlessly.
CommonMarketSection.paragraph2Rest: is striving for a fair play in the marketplace, always. This means that sellers must have ease of access to the market. Buyers should have a choice of suppliers to choose from. There should be no distortion through market domination or other means.
CommonMarketSection.paragraph3: The Bharatiya Vyapar Mahotsav '26 is a major step towards ensuring the vibrancy of the marketplace. The Indian Common Market is our ultimately national asset.

articles.title: Piyush Goyal Urges CAIT to Hold 'Biggest-Ever Swadeshi Mela' With ITPO
articles.description: Union Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal urged the Confederation of All India Traders (CAIT) to collaborate with ITPO and organise India's biggest-ever Swadeshi Mela, promoting indigenous products and strengthening domestic trade.

articles.title: Maiden 'Bhartiya Swadeshi Mela' in Delhi from Aug 12-15
articles.description: The Tribune India reported on the upcoming maiden Bhartiya Swadeshi Mela to be held in Delhi, spotlighting the event as a milestone for India's domestic trade ecosystem and Swadeshi movement.

articles.title: India To Host Its Biggest 'Swadeshi Expo' At Delhi's Pragati Maidan
articles.description: ABP Live covered India's upcoming biggest Swadeshi Expo at Pragati Maidan, New Delhi — a landmark event set to unite exhibitors, traders, and buyers from across the country under a single national platform.

articles.title: CAIT to Organise India's Largest National Trade Expo in August
articles.description: The Economic Times reported that CAIT is set to organise India's largest-ever national trade expo, bringing together thousands of traders, MSMEs, and industry stakeholders in a landmark event aimed at boosting domestic commerce.

articles.title: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal Urges Industry to Fast Track Import Substitution
articles.description: Minister of Commerce and Industry, Piyush Goyal asked the industry to seek opportunities in import substitution for both domestic manufacturing and reducing India's dependence on foreign goods.

articles.title: India Targets $1 Trillion Exports This Year, $2 Trillion in Five Years
articles.description: Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Shri Piyush Goyal said that India has set a target of achieving exports worth 1 trillion dollars this year and 2 trillion dollars in the next five years.

articles.title: Don't Depend Only on Subsidies for Growth
articles.description: Speaking at the Bhartiya Vyapar Mahotsav, Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal urged traders to focus on import substitution and build self-reliant businesses rather than depending solely on government subsidies.

articles.title: Shri Piyush Goyal Launches the Bharatiya Vyapar Mahotsav Website
articles.description: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal launches the Bharatiya Vyapar Mahotsav portal, a new trade fair initiative aimed at uniting India's trading community and promoting indigenous commerce on a national scale.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
content: Bharatiya Vyapar Mahotsav (BVM) 2026 ("BVM", "we", "us", "our") respects the privacy of individuals and is committed to protecting personal information shared with us.

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, process, and safeguard information obtained through our website, digital advertisements, lead generation forms, event registrations, and related communications, in accordance with applicable laws of India.

sections.title: 2. Information We Collect
content: When you interact with BVM, including through LinkedIn Lead Generation Forms, website enquiry forms, or registration platforms, we may collect the following information:
• Full name
• Company / organisation name
• Job title
• Official email address
• Contact number
• Business category or sector
• Turnover or scale information (only if voluntarily provided)
• Participation interests and objectives
We may also collect limited technical information such as IP address, browser type, device information, and website usage data through cookies or analytics tools.

sections.title: 3. Purpose of Collection & Use
content: Personal information collected by BVM is used for legitimate and lawful business purposes, including but not limited to:
• Responding to enquiries and expressions of interest
• Communicating regarding participation in BVM 2026
• Sharing event-related updates, opportunities, and official communications
• Assessing eligibility for exhibitor, partner, or sponsor participation
• Improving engagement, outreach, and operational efficiency
BVM does not sell, rent, or trade personal data to third parties.

sections.title: 4. Legal Basis for Processing
content: We process personal information on the following legal grounds:
• Consent provided by users at the time of form submission
• Legitimate business interests connected with event participation
• Performance of contractual or pre-contractual obligations
You may withdraw your consent at any time by writing to us at the contact details provided below.

sections.title: 5. Data Sharing & Disclosure
content: Personal information may be shared internally with authorised members of the BVM organising team or affiliated trade bodies strictly for participation assessment, coordination, and event execution purposes.
We do not disclose personal information to unrelated third parties for marketing or commercial exploitation, except where disclosure is required under applicable law or by a lawful authority.

sections.title: 6. Data Security
content: BVM adopts reasonable administrative, technical, and organisational security measures to protect personal information against unauthorised access, misuse, alteration, or disclosure. While we endeavour to safeguard data using industry-standard practices, no digital system can guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: 7. Data Retention
content: Personal information is retained only for as long as reasonably necessary to:
• Facilitate event-related communications
• Conduct post-event follow-ups
• Comply with legal, regulatory, or contractual obligations
Users may request deletion of their data at any time, subject to legal retention requirements.

sections.title: 8. User Rights
content: Subject to applicable law, you may:
• Request access to personal information held by us
• Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
• Request deletion of personal data
• Withdraw consent for further communications
Requests may be made by contacting us through the details provided below.

sections.title: 9. Cookies & Analytics
content: Our website may use cookies and analytics tools to enhance user experience and evaluate website performance. Users may disable cookies through their browser settings; however, some website features may be affected.

sections.title: 10. Governing Law & Jurisdiction
content: This Privacy Policy shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India, including the Information Technology Act, 2000 and applicable rules thereunder.
Courts at New Delhi shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any disputes arising from this Policy.

sections.title: 11. Contact Information
content: For privacy-related queries, consent withdrawal, or data requests, please contact:
Email: contactus@bvm2026.com
Organisation: Bharatiya Vyapar Mahotsav (BVM) 2026
Website: https://www.bharatiyavyaparmahotsav.com

sections.title: 12. Policy Updates
content: BVM reserves the right to update or modify this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be published on this page with an updated revision date.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
content: By accessing, browsing, registering on, or submitting information through the website, digital platforms, advertisements, forms, or communication channels of Bharatiya Vyapar Mahotsav (BVM) 2026 ("BVM", "we", "us", "our"), you agree to be bound by these Terms & Conditions ("Terms").
If you do not agree with these Terms, you are advised not to access or use BVM platforms or services.

sections.title: 2. Nature of the Event
content: BVM 2026 is a trade, business, and exhibition platform intended to facilitate engagement between exhibitors, sponsors, partners, delegates, and other stakeholders.
Participation in BVM 2026 is subject to eligibility assessment, availability, and confirmation by the organising authority.
Submission of an enquiry or expression of interest does not guarantee participation, allocation, sponsorship, or partnership.

sections.title: 3. Use of Website & Platforms
content: Users agree to:
• Provide accurate and lawful information
• Use the platform only for legitimate business purposes
• Refrain from any activity that may disrupt, harm, or misuse BVM systems or reputation
BVM reserves the right to restrict or terminate access to its platforms if misuse, misrepresentation, or unlawful activity is suspected.

sections.title: 4. Registration, Enquiries & Participation
content: All registrations, enquiries, or submissions made through BVM platforms are considered non-binding expressions of interest unless expressly confirmed in writing by BVM.
BVM reserves the right to:
• Accept or reject any participation request
• Modify event formats, dates, venues, or participation categories
• Allocate or reallocate exhibition space, sponsorships, or benefits
All commercial terms, if any, shall be governed by separate written agreements.

sections.title: 5. Payments & Commercial Arrangements
content: Any payments made towards participation, sponsorship, or partnership shall be governed by:
• The specific commercial agreement executed between parties, and
• Applicable payment terms communicated officially by BVM
• Unless otherwise agreed in writing, fees once paid may be non-refundable.
BVM shall not be responsible for indirect, consequential, or business losses.

sections.title: 6. Intellectual Property
content: All content, branding, logos, materials, layouts, and communications associated with BVM 2026 are the intellectual property of BVM or its licensors.
No content may be copied, reproduced, distributed, or used without prior written permission.
Participants remain responsible for ensuring that their own displayed materials do not infringe third-party intellectual property rights.

sections.title: 7. Data Protection & Privacy

sections.title: About this page
body: This page provides information about the screen reader software compatible with the Bharatiya Vyapar Mahotsav (BVM) 2026 website. We have built the site to conform to the Guidelines for Indian Government Websites (GIGW 3.0) and the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA, so that visitors with visual impairments can access the content using assistive technology of their choice.

sections.title: Built-in accessibility tools on this site
body: In addition to working with external screen readers, BVM 2026 includes its own accessibility toolbar — accessible from the icon at the top right of every page. The toolbar offers:
• Adjustable text size (default, large, extra large)
• Reduce motion (pauses background video, carousels, marquees)
• A built-in Read Aloud feature that uses your browser's speech engine to read the page in English or Hindi (where supported)
All preferences are saved in your browser and applied on every visit.

sections.title: Tips for screen reader users
body: • Press Tab from the top of the page to reveal the "Skip to main content" link, which jumps past the navigation.

• Major regions of each page are exposed as landmarks (banner, navigation, main, contentinfo) so you can jump between them using your screen reader's landmark shortcut (for example, D in NVDA, VO + U in VoiceOver).
• All registration forms are fully labelled and announce required fields, validation errors, and submission status.
• Decorative images and animations are hidden from assistive technology so they do not interrupt your reading flow.
